init.title: Oticat Energy options
init.description: A site's settings on dom.oti.cat choose which entities this Home Assistant reads and drives, so the page needs to know what there is. That list describes your house, so it only leaves when you allow it here.

data_description.share_catalogue: Send the entities a site can be pointed at: battery levels, energy and power sensors, the switches and climates devices are driven through, direction sensors marked as enums, and zones with coordinates. For each one, its entity id and name; no states and no history. Off by default, and only sent when the service asks for it while a site is being set up.

user.title: Oticat Energy
user.description: Connects to the Oticat Energy service. Add each inverter afterwards with its own site token.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Oticat Energy is already set up. Add more inverters to it instead.

user.title: Inverter
user.description: Everything about this site is set on dom.oti.cat, in Energy management: the battery, the solar panels, the grid contract, the high-consumption devices, and which entities in this Home Assistant it reads and drives. This side only needs the site's token, and it reports back what it has so the page can offer it.

data_description.token: Shown when the site is created on dom.oti.cat.
